title: Unique Buttery Greek Phyllo Baklava
description: A low-calorie friendly Greek dish featuring marmite and phyllo, served in a bento box. This adventurous recipe combines the savory flavor of marmite with the crunch of phyllo.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together the melted butter and marmite until well combined.
Layer the phyllo dough in a bento box, brushing each layer with the butter and marmite mixture.
Sprinkle the chopped walnuts and pistachios over the phyllo dough.
Drizzle the honey over the nuts.
Sprinkle the cinnamon and lemon zest over the top layer of phyllo dough.
Bake the baklava for 25 minutes, or until the phyllo dough is golden brown.
Allow the baklava to cool completely before serving.
Cut the baklava into small pieces and serve in the bento box.
